newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - NUMAR seen soaring.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - NUMAR seen soaring.

text.p: NUMAR Corp shares were expected to traded significantly higher at the open of trade Wednesday after Halliburton Co announced a takeover of the company after last night's market close, traders said.

Halliburton, an oil and natural gas company, said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire NUMAR, maker of devices to evaluate underground rock formations in oil and gas wells, for almost $40 per share in stock, or $360 million.
Preceding the market open NUMAR shares were quoted at 36 bid, 37 ask, up from 20-3/4 at Tuesday's Nasdaq close.
Halliburton said it will issue 0.4832 of a share for each outstanding NUMAR share, or 0.9664 of a share if the deal closes after Halliburton's 2-for-1 stock split, also announced Tuesday.
Halliburton made no moves before Wednesday's market open.
In after hours trade Tuesday, the shares added 1/4 to 80-7/8.
